messages.en: TickTock Meals: Urgent food rescue! 30 portions Curd Rice with Mustard Tempering (Pure Veg). Allergens: dairy (visual guess only). Safe until: 12:30 PM. Pickup Area: Yelahanka New Town. Reply ACCEPT to claim or DECLINE.
